name: The Meyer household at 2009 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_meyer_mrs_m_a

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 2009 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 2009 Mrs. M. A. Meyer; E. F., Albert, Carl and Abraham Meyer.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2009, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The five live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Mrs. M. A. Meyer
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Sarah Meyer here as head, born June 1842, in Germany, came to the United States in 1852, widowed (ED 40, sheet 12A, line 24, leaf n816).

persons.name: Miss Meyer
persons.note: The Blue Book prints '& dr.' after the household's name: an unmarried daughter at home, not named. 'Miss Meyer' is the book's own form of address, not a recorded name. The 1905 edition prints Mrs. M. A. Meyer without '& dr.'. The 1900 census lists Louise Meyer here as daughter, born December 1880 (the figures are hard to read), in Illinois, single, at school (ED 40, sheet 12A, line 29, leaf n816).

persons.note: A son is read from the shared surname under the head's listing; the Blue Book does not state the relationship. The 1900 census lists Edwin Meyer here as son, born December 1865, in Illinois, single, own business (ED 40, sheet 12A, line 25, leaf n816).
